title: Daggers Plugin
description: This plugin adds a new weapon type - daggers!
body:
# 🗡️ Daggers Plugin This plugin adds a full set of 6 daggers, ranging from Wooden to Netherite, offering a completely different combat playstyle compared to swords. # ⚔️ Combat Mechanics Daggers are designed for speed and precision, not raw power. ✅ Shorter range (2 blocks compared to the default 3) ✅ Lower base damage ✅ Faster attack speed (3.5 vs 1.6 on swords) ✅ Reduced knockback ✅ Same durability as their sword counterparts Perfect for aggressive, close-combat players who prefer fast combos over heavy hits. # ✨ Special Abilities
Each dagger comes with two unique abilities:

### 1️⃣ Triple Slash (Right Click)
Performs 3 consecutive fast hits in rapid succession. - Cooldown: 8 seconds
- Total damage: 150% of a normal hit
- Cooldown is displayed on screen
### 2️⃣ Precision Stab (Shift + Right Click)
Charges a powerful stab that deals a strong precise hit - Requires the target to stay in range for 0.75 seconds
- Total damage: 200% of a normal hit
- Cooldown: 15 seconds
- Cooldown is displayed on screen
# 🛠️ Crafting Daggers use a similar recipe to swords, but simpler: Only 1 material 1 stick Crafted vertically like a sword, but with one less material at the top # ⚠️ Important The Netherite Dagger does NOT use a Smithing Table. It is crafted using the same recipe pattern as the other daggers. # 🎯 Resource Pack The resource pack is included in the downloads. All that is required is to enable it in the resource pack menu.
Massive thanks to this project https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/daggers for providing the resource pack, all credit for it goes to the original author!
# ⚙️ Configuration The combat mechanics properties, as well as the damage table for all Dagger types can be modified in the plugin's configuration file, which can be found in the /plugins/Daggers folder.
